avis.titre: Named acne patches but says "for dark spots"

There are many reviews saying they didnt work for their acne and im guessing this would be why. I keep giving creme products a try, BUT i always noticed alot of the packaging is confusing like this. Its like they add extra words trying to get more poeple to buy things that it isnt for.

avis.titre: Prevents picking, absorbs oil and fluids
avis.texte: I've used these patches for about a week on a combination of cystic acne, untouched white heads, and pimples I've picked. They work well to reduce inflammation and promote healing when you've already picked a zit as you can see the white texture on the patch of what it's absorbed after you've left it on over night. It does not extract pus from cysts but as a habitual skin picker, it prevents me from touching active pimples, preventing them from getting further inflamed and infected. They definitely reduces the time they hang around because it keeps the skin clean and prevents picking while absorbing oils/dirt. Not a cure all, but definitely has helped heal my skin faster.

avis.titre: Ingredients are different online versus on the package
avis.texte: I was looking specifically for one ingredient Hydrocolloid acne patches and this one came up. However when I received the package it has at least 8 other ingredients one of them being tea tree oil which my face is sensitive too.

These work ok- so far they seem to work as well as other hydrocolloid patches I've used, however the issue with these is they stick to the inside of the package!!! Half of these stuck to the package when I was trying to take one of the sheets out.

These work well enough to cover blemishes and to prevent picking at the skin. They didn't do anything to cure the acne and I used additional medication under the patches. If you want something to actually help heal the breakouts, try another brand with more medication in the patches. But these are cute!
They are literally just stickers, I have tried these several times. On different stages of different acne spots, did not make a difference on any of them.

avis.titre: Does What It Says (But It's Not Magic)
avis.texte: I'm in my late 30s with sensitive skin that's oily in summer, dry in winter and just an overall mess most of the time. I got some plain, non-medicated zit stickers elsewhere and they helped a lot just by covering the zit so it didn't accumulate more oil through the day. These ones work the same way but the tea tree seems to reduce the size of the zit and/or get the deep ones to develop a head so they can be extracted. These are also cuter than the plain version (a little bit quirky on an adult but whatever) and I've worn them during the day under the bridge of my glasses on one side to keep the zit that I keep getting there to stop it from getting worse. Like the other reviews say, they aren't magic and they won't make your zits magically disappear in a couple hours and they're too small to cover the really big cystic acne---but if you use them for like 24 hours they will do some serious work.
it's okay but i still have my spot on my face so i'm going to try the patches again but i wish it would work the first time.
